definitions.explanation: A published book collecting a poet's poems, either by one author or as an anthology.

examples.japanese: {詩集|ししゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a collection of poems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詩集|ししゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She published her first collection of poems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詩集|ししゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I borrowed a famous poet's collection of poems from the library.

notes:
{詩集|ししゅう} combines ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧ (poem) and {集|しゅう} (collection), the same pattern as {作品集|さくひんしゅう} (collected works) or ⟦{全集|ぜんしゅう}→全集：11783_zenshuu⟧ (complete works).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詩集|ししゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to publish a poetry collection
- {詩集|ししゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧: to compile a poetry collection
- ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詩集|ししゅう}: one's first poetry collection
